findings.finding: The public hiring input excludes Wiki evidence IDs, protected locators, gap classifications, and next actions. The resolver receives public-safe Wiki metadata only after the hiring report exists.

Thirty-four stable requirements distinguish visible proof, qualified evidence, weak projection, hard screens, applicant-only facts, source review, and true depth gaps instead of averaging them into one fit score.

Private application status, warm paths, work authorization, communications, and raw archival evidence remain outside the repository. Source-channel coverage records access and public-use limits without exposing source paths or message bodies.

Live roles carry official sources and 48-to-72-hour reverification windows. Title-blind discovery ranks all six priorities above nursing-license, production-Rust, and quota-carrying sales controls, while hard screens remain explicit.

Gaps lead to bounded actions: clarify public wording, review original sources, seek corroboration, prepare an application artifact, or preserve an experience gap. The system never promotes access, adjacency, or an AI course into unsupported production authority.

remainingHumanWork: Jamie retains authority over source review, collaborator consent, application answers, and publication decisions.
Official postings must be reverified after July 21, 2026 if they remain live priorities.
Named profiles remain simulated lenses and require no inference about private beliefs.
